story_overview: Eli works in a ceramics studio, carries a finished white vase into the storeroom, then revisits the studio and brings in a shallow wooden tray. The studio otherwise keeps the same arrangement.

video_prompts: In the same daylight ceramics studio, a wide doorway view shows Eli, a man in a gray work shirt, standing beside the central worktable.
From the kiln side of the same studio, a medium reverse view shows Eli inspecting a finished white vase on the worktable.
A low close view across the worktable shows Eli placing both hands around the white vase; only nearby tools are visible.
A side view shows Eli carrying the white vase out through the storeroom door, leaving the worktable behind.
action_descriptions: A wide view establishes Eli and the ceramics studio.
A reverse view shows Eli inspecting a white vase.
A close view shows Eli grasping the vase.
Eli carries the vase out of the studio.

video_prompts: In the compact storeroom beside the studio, Eli places the finished white vase on an open shelf. The frame shows only Eli and part of the shelving.
action_descriptions: Eli places the white vase on a storeroom shelf.

video_prompts: The same wide doorway view returns to the ceramics studio. The white vase is gone from the worktable, Eli is empty-handed, and the rest of the studio remains as before.
From the opposite side of the same worktable, Eli returns carrying a shallow wooden tray and sets it on the cleared spot.
A close view shows the wooden tray resting on the worktable as Eli steps away; the far side of the studio is outside the frame.
action_descriptions: The ceramics studio is revisited after the vase has been removed.
Eli brings in a wooden tray and sets it on the worktable.
A close view confirms the tray remains on the worktable.
